versions.content: API Function Header File Description Fr If _ Get Global Time Fr If.h Wraps the Flex Ray Driver API function Fr_ Get Global Time(). Important Note: Fr If_ Get Global Time may be called within an exclusive area. Fr If _ Transmit Fr If.h Requests transmission of a PDU. Nm _ Bus Sleep Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Bus - Sleep Mode. Nm _ Network Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Network Mode. Nm _ Synchronize - Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Synchronize Mode. Nm _ Tx Timeout - Exception Nm.h Service to indicate that an attempt to send an NM message failed.
